questions.question: Who has been reappointed as the Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of HDFC Life in April 2026 for a five-year term?

questions.question: According to the UN Women report released in April 2026, by what factor has the number of sexual violence survivors requiring support in Sudan increased since the conflict began three years ago?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Quadrupled**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• A report by **UN Women** titled **"Three years of war: Sudanese women on the frontlines of humanitarian and local peacebuilding efforts"** reveals that sexual violence has become a defining feature of the **Sudan war**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The report highlights that the number of survivors of **sexual violence** requiring support has **quadrupled** since the conflict began **three years ago**.
 
• Specifically, the number of survivors needing support **nearly doubled in two years**, showing an accelerating trend as the war enters its **fourth year**.
 
• Data from 85 **women-led organisations** indicate that violations are being used to inflict **terror, humiliation, and control** with widespread impunity.
 
• Surveys show **two-thirds** of front-line responders reported a significant increase in sexual violence in **2025**, and half reported further escalation in **2026**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• More than **4.3 million women and girls** are internally displaced within **Sudan** due to the ongoing conflict.
 
• It is estimated that **17.1 million people** will require **humanitarian assistance** in Sudan in **2026**.
 
• **Anna Mutavati**, the UN Women’s **Regional Director for East and Southern Africa**, stated that sexual violence has been "embedded in the blueprint of Sudan’s war."
 
• Despite challenges, **women-led organisations** are reaching nearly **20 million people** in need across the country.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• **Comparison with other options:**
 
• **Doubled:** This refers to the increase in survivors needing support over the last **two years**, but not the total increase since the start of the war.
 
• **Tripled and Quintupled:** These figures are incorrect based on the factual data provided in the **UN Women report**, which explicitly states the number has **quadrupled** over the three-year period.

questions.question: What is the revised outlay for the Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana-III (PMGSY-III) following its extension approved by the Union Cabinet in April 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Rs. 83,977 crore**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The **Union Cabinet**, chaired by Prime Minister **Shri Narendra Modi**, has approved the continuation of **Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana-III (PMGSY-III)** beyond March 2025 up to **March 2028**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The **revised outlay** of the scheme is **Rs. 83,977 crore**, increased from the original outlay of **Rs. 80,250 crore**.
 
• The extension aims to complete the **consolidation of Through Routes** and **Major Rural Links** that connect habitations to **Gramin Agricultural Markets (GrAMs)**, **Higher Secondary Schools**, and **Hospitals**.
 
• The timeline for completing roads and bridges in **plain areas** and roads in **hilly areas** has been extended till **March 2028**.
 
• For **bridges in hilly areas**, the completion timeline is extended further till **March 2029**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The Cabinet also approved the sanctioning and tendering of **161 Long Span Bridges (LSBs)** with an estimated cost of **Rs. 961 crore** that were pending but located on already sanctioned roads.
 
• The scheme focuses on **upgrading rural roads** to enhance market access for agricultural and non-farm products, thereby boosting **rural incomes** and **employment**.
 
• The project contributes to the vision of **Viksit Bharat 2047** by bridging the rural-urban divide.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• The extension ensures **socio-economic benefits** through better access to education and healthcare institutions in **remote and underserved areas**.
 
• Works sanctioned before **March 31, 2025**, but un-awarded, are now eligible for tender and award under this extension.

questions.question: In which city did Indian archer Payal Nag win a historic gold medal at the World Para Archery Series Final in April 2026, becoming the world’s first quadruple amputee to do so?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Bangkok**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Indian archer Payal Nag, a quadruple amputee, achieved a historic gold medal at the World Para Archery Series Final in Bangkok on April 4, 2026.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Event Location: The historic victory took place in Bangkok, Thailand, during the World Para Archery Series Final.
 
• Opponent: Payal Nag defeated her idol and fellow Indian archer Sheetal Devi with a score of 139-136 in the final.
 
• Debut Success: This was Payal's debut senior international event, marking a significant milestone in para sports history.
 
• Unique Status: She is recognized as the world's first quadruple amputee (limbless) archer to compete and win at this level.
 
• Comparison of Options: While Jaipur was the site of the 2025 Para Archery Nationals and Katra is where her academy is located, Bangkok is specifically cited in the news as the venue for her 2026 World Series gold medal win.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Background: Payal Nag is an 18-year-old from Odisha’s Balangir district. She lost all four limbs in an electrocution accident at the age of eight.
 
• Training: She was trained by coach Kuldeep Kumar Vedwan at the Maata Vaishno Devi Shrine Archery Academy in Katra.
 
• Shooting Technique: Unlike Sheetal Devi who uses her feet, Payal uses a custom prosthetic arm to stabilize the bow and draws it using her shoulder, mouth, and a special trigger mechanism.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• Payal Nag's journey from a rural village in Odisha to the international podium is considered a testament to willpower and self-belief.
 
• Her coach, Kuldeep Vedwan, emphasized that their success is a result of belief and hard work rather than just resources.
 
• The victory is seen as a precursor to her potential participation in the Paralympics.

questions.question: Which Indian Navy ship arrived at Mombasa, Kenya, in April 2026 as part of its deployment in the South West Indian Ocean Region?

questions.question: The National Education Society for Tribal Students (NESTS), an ___________ institution, celebrated its ________ Foundation Day on April 1, 2026.
questions.solution:

• **NESTS is an autonomous organization established under the Ministry of Tribal Affairs specifically to manage Eklavya Model Residential Schools (EMRS).**

questions.question: In April 2026, NTPC Limited signed an MoU with _____________ to explore the development of nuclear power projects in India.
questions.solution:

__

• The agreement was signed by **Arnada Prasad Samal**, CGM (Nuclear Cell) of NTPC, and **Vakisasi Ramany**, Senior VP of EDF, following **Government of India** approvals.

questions.question: Who has been elected as the President of the newly formed Odisha Steel Producers' Association (OSPA) in April 2026?

__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

questions.question: What is the name of the operation launched by the Indian Army’s Trishakti Corps in April 2026 to evacuate stranded tourists in North Sikkim?
questions.solution:

__
 
• In **April 2026**, the **Indian Army’s Trishakti Corps** launched **Operation Him Setu** to evacuate tourists stranded due to a landslide in **North Sikkim**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Operation Him Setu**: This specific operation was initiated by the **Indian Army** to provide relief and restore connectivity after a massive landslide disrupted the road between **Lachen** and **Chungthang**.
 
• The operation is being carried out by the **Trishakti Corps**, which operates under the **Eastern Command** of the **Indian Army**.
 
• The primary objective is the **evacuation of stranded tourists** and the restoration of road access in the **North Sikkim** region despite severe weather and **heavy snowfall**.
 
• So far, the troops have successfully evacuated **135 tourists**, along with **32 light vehicles** and **10 motorcycles**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• The **Border Roads Organisation (BRO)** is working in close coordination with the **Trishakti Corps** for road clearance and **snow removal**.
 
• The rescue efforts are being conducted in **phases** to ensure the safety of all individuals involved in the challenging terrain.
 
• Critical passes have been opened and **alternate routes** activated to facilitate the smooth movement of trapped vehicles.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• **Lachen and Chungthang**: These are the key locations in **North Sikkim** where connectivity was severed by the landslide.
 
• **Trishakti Corps**: The wing of the **Indian Army** leading the rescue and restoration efforts under the **Eastern Command**.
 
• **Scope of Operation**: It involves not just human rescue but also the recovery of **light vehicles** and **motorcycles**.

questions.question: What is the revised growth forecast for India for FY27 as per the latest report by Morgan Stanley released in April 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**6.2%**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Morgan Stanley has reduced India’s GDP growth forecast for the fiscal year 2027 (FY27) to 6.2% from its previous estimate of 6.5%.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Revised Growth Forecast:** Morgan Stanley has cut the FY27 growth forecast for India to 6.2% (down from 6.5%) citing risks from the ongoing war in West Asia.
 
• **Inflation Outlook:** The brokerage has simultaneously raised the inflation forecast to 5.1% from an earlier projection of 4% due to expected elevated energy prices and supply-side constraints.
 
• **Current Account Deficit (CAD):** The current account deficit is projected to widen significantly to 2.5% of GDP, compared to the earlier projection of 1%.
 
• **Oil Price Assumptions:** These projections are based on crude oil prices averaging at $95 per barrel in FY27.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Moody’s Ratings:** Trimmed India's growth outlook for the current fiscal year to 6% from 6.8% due to West Asia conflict risks.
 
• **Goldman Sachs:** Lowered its 2026 growth forecast for India to 5.9% from 7%.
 
• **S&P Global Ratings:** In contrast to other agencies, S&P raised its projections for FY27 to 7.1% (an increase of 40 basis points).

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• If oil prices spike to $150 a barrel for a quarter, Morgan Stanley warns that India's GDP growth could drop further to 5.7%, retail inflation could breach 6%, and the CAD could widen to 3% of GDP.
 
• The differing forecasts from Morgan Stanley, Moody's, and S&P reflect high uncertainty regarding the duration and intensity of the crisis in West Asia.
